title: change.propose request
description: params of change.propose: an ordered, all-or-nothing batch applied as one private candidate on base_snapshot (or on an open candidate). request_id plus the input fingerprint make it idempotent.

candidate.description: Extend this open candidate instead of starting one. Its base must equal base_snapshot.

checks.description: Checks to run on the final candidate before returning; compile always runs.
